players.product: Power-first greenfield AI data-center campuses on 15-year triple-net leases (River Bend LA for Anthropic; Beacon Point TX) - ex-Bitcoin-mining platform (American Bitcoin affiliate)

quarterly_data.signal: Second Beacon Point (Nueces County, Texas) triple-net lease with the unnamed high-investment-grade Phase 1 tenant: the lease carries a 3.0% annual base rent escalator; the campus's 1,000 MW of utility capacity is secured under an interconnection agreement with AEP Texas for electric delivery service, and no incremental capacity is required to serve the Phase 2 lease. The second AI factory is designed to NVIDIA's DSX reference architecture, supported by 500 MW of utility capacity; initial Phase 2 data hall delivery is expected in Q2 2028, long-lead critical equipment has been procured and initial energization remains on schedule for Q1 2027. Three 5-year renewal options per lease could raise campus-level contract value to $50.2 billion. The contracted portfolio comprises 704 MW at Beacon Point and 245 MW at River Bend, supported by 1,330 MW of utility capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: 3.0% annual base rent escalator; 1,000 MW utility capacity under AEP Texas interconnection agreement; 500 MW utility capacity for the second DSX AI factory; Phase 2 delivery Q2 2028; energization Q1 2027; renewal options to $50.2 billion; River Bend 245 MW; 1,330 MW utility capacity
